sources.title: Confluence pricing (official, page content did not render fully in this session)
Confluence Pricing 2026: 4 Plans from Free to $10.44/user/month

keyLimits.en: Up to 10 users on the workspace.
Advanced permissions, 100 automation rule runs/month, unlimited pages, page insights, 250GB storage.
Unlimited automation rules, advanced admin controls, unlimited whiteboards, analytics, priority support, 1TB storage.

cautions.en: Per-user rates decrease as team size grows, so a small team's effective price per seat can be higher than headline figures suggest.
cautions.fr: Le prix par utilisateur diminue avec la taille de l'équipe, donc une petite équipe peut payer plus cher par siège que ne le laissent penser les tarifs affichés.

capabilities.en: Team wiki and knowledge base for technical documentation, shared with rich page editing.
Page permissions, spaces and templates for organizing documentation by team or project.
Automation rules and whiteboards on higher tiers for structured collaboration.
Tight integration with other Atlassian products (Jira) for linking documentation to work items.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 10 users, unsuitable for any team beyond a very small group.
Automation rules are capped at 100 runs/month on Standard; unlimited automation requires Premium.
Advanced admin controls, analytics and priority support are Premium-and-above only.

missingAlternatives.name: Notion
missingAlternatives.reason: Widely used alternative for team documentation and knowledge bases; appears in catalogue as notion, worth linking as an alternative at editorial stage.

unknowns: The official Atlassian pricing page (atlassian.com/software/confluence/pricing) returned truncated content on repeated fetch attempts in this session; plan prices above are sourced from an independent 2026 pricing round-up (tier 2), not verified directly against the official page.
Monthly (non-annual) billing rate per plan not confirmed; only annual per-user rates were found.
